# Nya (its_nya_music)

> Nya, also known as its_nya_music, is a hyperpop artist from Germany, rapping and singing in German and English. The debut album NYAVERSE is out now, released July 24, 2026 (self-released, 13 tracks).

## Main pages

- [Official website](https://itsnyamusic.com/): the artist homepage, with all official profiles and streaming links
- [NYAVERSE album page](https://itsnyamusic.com/nyaverse/): debut album details, cover and full tracklist
- [NYAVERSE lyrics](https://itsnyamusic.com/nyaverse/lyrics/): full lyrics for all 13 tracks, in German and English, published by the artist
- [Promo site](https://itsnyamusic.com/promo/): bio, discography and videos
- [Press](https://itsnyamusic.com/press/): press coverage of Nya, headlined by a full interview in the Hertener Allgemeine newspaper, with reviews and features in HipHopEargasm, Foxfire Magazine, Freim TV and La Caverna, plus picks from Kickdrum Magazin, 7 Tage - 7 Songs and curator amara.bside
- [Features & credits](https://itsnyamusic.com/credits/): Nya's work on other artists' records, covering guest features and production/mixing credits
- [Shop](https://itsnyamusic.com/shop): official merch store (Nya and NYAVERSE tees and hoodies), hosted on Fourthwall at https://nya-xiq-shop.fourthwall.com/
- [Bandcamp](https://itsnyamusic.bandcamp.com/): buy and download music, including the NYAVERSE album at https://itsnyamusic.bandcamp.com/album/nyaverse

## Key facts

- Artist name: Nya. Handle on all platforms: its_nya_music
- Debut album: NYAVERSE, out now (released July 24, 2026), self-released, 13 tracks in German and English
- Guest features on NYAVERSE: Naeyiwu, Mhhh7887, Vain
- Earlier releases: the EPs Duality (2021, 5 tracks), It's Hyperpop (2023, 3 tracks) and Summer Vibes (2024, 5 tracks), plus singles including Messer (2026), Denk Wieder an Dich (2026), BEDWARS (2025), Sweet Monster Energy (2025)
- Summer Vibes (EP, released 2024-07-05, 5 tracks): Salitos (feat. YoungKiwi), Anschluss, Achterbahn (feat. Naeyiwu), 3 Flaschen Wein (feat. Mhhh7887), Letzte Kippe (feat. lame girl kya)
- Work on other artists' records: mixing on YoungKiwi's "Kiba" (2026), guest features on Naeyiwu's "TOXICBITCH" and "KLIMAKLEBER AUFM MOND" (2025, SoundCloud), Kay Trueluv's "off the net" (2024), Mhhh7887's "Gefühle in den Schrank" (2024) and Naeyiwu's "Down" (2021, from the album FLYEST ALIVE, SoundCloud). Full list at https://itsnyamusic.com/credits/
